<previous_draft>
## Problem
When a policyholder reports the same incident through different channels, such as by phone and through the web portal, the Keelwater system creates separate claims without warning. This duplicate loss report scenario leads to inaccurate reserves, complicates payments and supplier coordination, and causes confusion for adjusters because duplicates are not detected or linked at intake [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:72656010c210a80e]. Customers report having to manually cross-check and link claims after the fact, which delays work [i:82e08d8615bf7651][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].

## Who is affected
- **Claims adjusters and operations staff** who must spend time manually cross-checking new claims to avoid duplicates, time they "could spend on supplier coordination or reporting" [i:82e08d8615bf7651].
- **Finance and reporting teams** who deal with inaccurate reserves and reporting due to duplicate records [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:603ee96296d14553].
- **At least seven customer accounts** have raised this issue through multiple routes [i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e].

## Evidence
The issue has been mentioned 16 times by 7 accounts across 3 routes: onboarding, sales, and support [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e]. The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the accounts with specified ARR in the fact sheet is £5,220,000.0 [i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932]. Two accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days [i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0].

- **Onboarding (3 mentions)**: During implementation, customers like Pendleford Motor Mutual and Callowfield Auto Assurance identified the lack of duplicate detection as a system shortfall. One customer stated, "the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves" [i:2b2412a21ba06c15].
- **Sales (4 mentions)**: In sales conversations, prospects like Sallowmere Motor describe the problem as a pain point they want solved, noting it "messes up our reserves and supplier coordination" [i:603ee96296d14553]. An existing customer, Pendleford Motor Mutual, also raised it in a sales context, calling it "messy" [i:847e58c1a543471c].
- **Support (9 mentions)**: Multiple live accounts have submitted support tickets describing operational impacts. Tarnholt Drive Cover explained they are "manually cross-checking every new claim" [i:82e08d8615bf7651]. Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reported seeing "disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work" [i:e662b0d940a820b4]. Ravensgill Insurance and Hollinbrook Home Insurance have also reported the issue, confirming it creates duplicate records [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:dadf780eadfacb5e].

## Why now
The problem is actively disrupting daily operations and financial reporting for multiple customers. Two customers, Tarnholt Drive Cover and Hollinbrook Home Insurance, have renewals due on 2027-01-09 and 2027-01-15, respectively [i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0]. The volume of support tickets (9 mentions) indicates the issue is a persistent, ongoing pain rather than a one-time concern [i:72656010c210a80e][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. Furthermore, prospects in sales conversations are explicitly noting the problem as a barrier, with one thanking a salesperson for help "until the system catches up" [i:4fbd615ae6ea6760], indicating competitive vulnerability.
</previous_draft>
